repairs.effect: Initial source materializer process could not import the repository package.
repairs.repair: Prepend the existing V37 repository root to sys.path in the WSL entry point.

repairs.effect: Initial date workers compared the complete 582-row issue ledger against the 339-row temporal-flexible cohort count and failed before optimization.
repairs.repair: Apply the frozen 339 and 336 invariants to temporal_flexible rows only; the 243 RUNNING_FIXED rows remain present and unchanged.

repairs.effect: The frozen recursive optimizer-channel materializer retained its V28R2 April-only entry guard and rejected May before any solve.
repairs.repair: V37 binds the unchanged frozen recursive prediction implementation behind a May01-May31 scope guard without modifying V28R2.

repairs.effect: OpenDSS Compile changed the date worker process working directory. A later frozen beam invocation therefore resolved its relative cache root against the source feeder directory, and the unrestricted exception handler incorrectly attempted B=4 for this filesystem error.
repairs.repair: Reset the date worker working directory to the V37 repository at every frozen runner boundary and after every return or exception. Permit B=2 to B=4 only for the frozen beam search's explicit conservation, restricted-count, or no-feasible-seed failures.

repairs.effect: The V37 beam adapter did not invoke the already-frozen 200 -> 400 -> 800 -> FULL hierarchy when a restricted local-search candidate remained uncertified after its prescribed numeric retry.
repairs.repair: Connect explicit fixed-candidate certification failures to the frozen K hierarchy, isolate only those uncertified candidates fail-closed, retain every attempt as an auditable cache artifact, and accept FULL only after scanning the entire dynamically feasible candidate set.

repairs.effect: Concurrent date-status writers shared one PID-derived temporary filename, and brief Windows reader locks could reject the final atomic replace and terminate the progress watcher.
repairs.repair: Use PID plus thread identity for each temporary JSON and retry only PermissionError during os.replace for at most one second.

repairs.effect: Completed K=200 and K=400 certification-failure attempts were archived for audit but were not consulted after a process interruption.
repairs.repair: Restore the latest exact-parent archived restricted-scan attempt and skip only levels whose explicit certification failure is already materialized.
